correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

bg=6
patterns={
1:[[0,0,1],[1,1,1],[0,0,1]], # top 1 shape? verify
3:[[0,1,1],[0,1,1],[1,0,0]],
7:[[0,1,1],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]],
5:[[0,1,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,0]],
}
# build 13x13 output
out=[[bg]*13 for _ in range(13)]
for color, r0,c0 in [(1,1,1),(3,1,7),(7,7,1),(5,7,7)]:
    p=patterns[color]
    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5):
            # solid panel except its interior holes matching foreground shape
            val=color
            if 1<=r<=3 and 1<=c<=3 and p[r-1][c-1]: val=bg
            out[r0+r][c0+c]=val
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
